valor: Dos vidas en paralelo: Dante Alighieri, poeta del siglo XIV, sufre con su «Divina comedia», y Nick Tosches, escritor del siglo XXI, recibe de un capo de la mafia el encargo de robar un manuscrito de esa obra maestra. Oscar Isaac interpreta a ambos.

antes.tribeca-2026: Un erudito es contratado por la mafia para autenticar un manuscrito de la Divina Comedia que aparece en el mercado negro de Nueva York. Vencido por la tentación, lo roba e inicia un violento descenso por su propio infierno.

valor: Lives run in parallel in Julian Schnabel’s ode to art and the ineffability of creativity as Oscar Isaac takes on the dual roles of 14th Century poet Dante Alighieri, who is agonizing over his Divine Comedy, and 21st century author Nick Tosches, who is tasked by a mafia don to steal a handwritten manuscript of the poet’s masterpiece.

antes.tribeca-2026: A scholar is hired by the mob to authenticate a manuscript of the Divine Comedy that surfaces in the New York black market. Overcome by temptation, he steals it — and begins a violent descent through his own inferno.
